name: Test Pasta
description: A simple test pasta recipe for automated tests.
author: Test Kitchen
recipeInstructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil.
Cook pasta according to package directions until al dente.
Meanwhile, sauté garlic in olive oil over medium heat for 2 minutes.
Drain pasta, reserving 1/4 cup pasta water.
Toss pasta with garlic oil, parmesan, and pasta water. Season with salt.
